create_coefficient_mapping: create a CoefficientMapping module to manage spherical harmonic coefficient indices for given lmax and mmax values
get_coefficient_indices: get coefficient indices for a specific degree l and order m using the coefficient_idx method
transform_irreps_to_grid: transform an irreps embedding tensor to a 2D grid representation using SO3_Grid to_grid method
transform_grid_to_irreps: transform a 2D grid tensor back to irreps representation using SO3_Grid from_grid method
precompute_rotation_rescale_matrices: precompute inverse rotation rescale matrices for all degree and order combinations using pre_compute_rotate_inv_rescale
